steps.en: Add the toolkit to your web app
steps.zh: 把工具库装进你的 Web 应用

steps.en: Mount a modeler on a DOM node
steps.zh: 把一个建模器挂到 DOM 节点

steps.en: Draws the process as interactive SVG with palette, context pad and BPMN-compliant rules
steps.zh: 画成可交互 SVG，带调色板与 BPMN 合规规则

steps.en: Keeps the model BPMN-valid and exports schema-compliant BPMN 2.0 XML
steps.zh: 保持模型 BPMN 合规，导出标准 BPMN 2.0 XML

value.en: Standards-correct BPMN modeling inside your own UI, with diagrams any BPMN engine can read
value.zh: 在你自己的界面里做符合标准的 BPMN 建模，产出的图任何 BPMN 引擎都读得懂

sources: bpmn.io bpmn-js Walkthrough (retrieved 2026-09-28): 'npm install bpmn-js'; 'const modeler = new Modeler({ container: '#canvas' });'; 'await modeler.importXML(bpmnXML);'; diagram-js provides Canvas/ContextPad/Palette and BpmnRules enforces BPMN modeling rules; bpmn-moddle reads/writes BPMN 2.0 XML
bpmn-io/bpmn-js README (develop, retrieved 2026-09-28): viewer usage snippet 'new BpmnJS({ container: 'body' })' + 'viewer.importXML(xml)'
